verdicts.reading: The Lagrangian velocity has Stokes parameters: plane waves are rectilinearly polarized (stretch Q,U with exact 2-theta covariance; spin V = 0 to machine precision) and vortices circularly polarized (V maximal, Q,U -> 0).  The deep ocean is wave-polarized at the equator -- Q/I = +0.44 (t = +48), the equatorial deep jets as the extreme linear limit, with the smallest spin -- and vortex-polarizes poleward: |V| grows monotonically from 0.054 to 0.107 while the stretch collapses, crossing at ~20-35 deg; at 65-85 deg the stretch flips MERIDIONAL (-0.032, t = -2.3) as boundary steering replaces beta.  Wave/vortex partition is polarimetry: two moments per float, no spectra, no maps.
